about.heading: Who am I
about.title: Between development, investing and technical curiosity
about.bio: Hi there! I'm a Blockchain Developer and Crypto Investor. I love building around Web3 (Solidity, EVM, React) and backing projects I believe in.

blockchain.title: Blockchains
blockchain.description: Understanding major blockchain ecosystems and their approaches: Bitcoin, Ethereum, EVM chains, Cosmos, Solana, Polkadot and scalability-focused networks.

bitcoin.name: Bitcoin
bitcoin.description: The first decentralized cryptocurrency, designed as a store of value and peer-to-peer monetary network.

ethereum.name: Ethereum
ethereum.description: A major programmable blockchain at the core of smart contracts, DeFi, NFTs and EVM applications.

polkadot.name: Polkadot
polkadot.description: An interoperability-focused ecosystem built around parachains and a relay chain.

solana.name: Solana
solana.description: A high-performance blockchain designed for fast and low-cost transactions.

multiversx.name: Elrond / MultiversX
multiversx.description: A scalable blockchain using sharding, with an ecosystem focused on applications and performance.

cosmos.name: Cosmos
cosmos.description: An ecosystem of sovereign blockchains interconnected through IBC.

smartContracts.title: Smart Contracts
smartContracts.description: Development and interaction with EVM contracts: ERC standards, Solidity, libraries, developer tooling and frontend integration.

solidity.name: Solidity
solidity.description: The main language for writing smart contracts on Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains.

evm.name: EVM
evm.description: The virtual machine that executes smart contracts on Ethereum and many compatible blockchains.

erc20.name: ERC-20
erc20.description: The fungible token standard used for stablecoins, DeFi tokens and exchangeable assets.

erc721.name: ERC-721
erc721.description: The NFT standard where each token is unique and individually identifiable.

openzeppelin.name: OpenZeppelin
openzeppelin.description: A library of secure and reusable contracts that speeds up Solidity development.

ethers.name: ethers.js
ethers.description: A JavaScript library used to interact with wallets, contracts and RPC endpoints from a frontend app.

defi.title: DeFi
defi.description: Understanding decentralized finance mechanisms: AMMs, lending, staking, liquidity, bridges, yield and associated risks.

amm.name: AMM
amm.description: An automated market maker that allows assets to be exchanged through liquidity pools.

uniswap.name: Uniswap
uniswap.description: A major DEX in the Ethereum ecosystem, based on liquidity pools.

aave.name: Aave
aave.description: A lending protocol that allows users to borrow or lend crypto assets.

staking.name: Staking
staking.description: A security or yield mechanism based on locking assets.

bridges.name: Bridges
bridges.description: Tools used to transfer assets or messages between different blockchains.

yield.name: Yield
yield.description: Seeking returns through lending, liquidity providing, staking or DeFi strategies.

wallets.title: Wallets & self-custody
wallets.description: Advanced use of wallets, signatures, approvals, hardware wallets and the digital sovereignty mindset behind private key ownership.

metamask.name: MetaMask
metamask.description: A widely used EVM wallet for signing transactions and interacting with dApps.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.description: A hardware wallet used to keep private keys offline.

keplr.name: Keplr
keplr.description: The main wallet for the Cosmos ecosystem.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.description: A popular Solana wallet that is increasingly becoming multi-chain.

approvals.name: Approvals
approvals.description: Permissions given to contracts to move specific tokens: powerful, but risky.

signatures.name: Signatures
signatures.description: Signing a message or transaction with a wallet, without always transferring funds.

infrastructure.title: Web3 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Reading and displaying on-chain data through RPCs, explorers, APIs, layer 2 networks, rollups and blockchain infrastructure tools.

rpc.name: RPC
rpc.description: An access point that allows an application to read from and send data to a blockchain.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: A Web3 infrastructure provider for RPCs, NFTs, tokens and on-chain data.

explorers.name: Explorers
explorers.description: Tools like Etherscan used to explore transactions, contracts, blocks and wallets.

layer2.name: Layer 2
layer2.description: Networks built on top of Ethereum to improve scalability and reduce fees.

rollups.name: Rollups
rollups.description: Solutions that execute transactions outside L1 while publishing proofs or data to Ethereum.

tokenApis.name: Token APIs
tokenApis.description: APIs used to retrieve balances, metadata, prices and token history.

security.title: Security & Risks
security.description: Focus on approvals, phishing, signatures, protocol risks, wallet security and the limits of self-custody.

phishing.name: Phishing
phishing.description: Attacks designed to make users sign something dangerous or reveal critical information.

multisig.name: Multisig
multisig.description: A wallet that requires multiple signatures to execute a transaction.

mev.name: MEV basics
mev.description: Value extraction related to transaction ordering inside a block.

riskAnalysis.name: Risk analysis
riskAnalysis.description: Evaluating technical, economic, smart contract and UX risks of a protocol.
